summary: Luxury Two-Bedroom Apartment To Let – Prime West End Location with Gated Community An exceptional opportunity to rent a stunning, spacious two-bedroom apartment in the highly sought-after West End. Recently refurbished throughout to a high modern standard, this beautiful apartment offers stylish contemporary living in a prime location. Boasting two generously sized double bedrooms, spacious living accommodation and modern fixtures and fittings throughout, the property has been finished to an excellent standard. Further benefits include private parking, making this an ideal home for professionals, couples or anyone looking for luxury living in a desirable location. A fantastic apartment in a prime position. Early viewing is highly recommended.
